result_event.result: [{"item":"①","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.threats","reason":"競爭軸的三條負向 finding（competitive_share_entrants#0/#1/#2）都已寫進 moat.threats 並附 evidence_refs，Muse 與 Gen AI 繞過也進了 contradictions 和 Single Thing；customer_second_source 不適用，無漏接。"},{"item":"②","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.thesis.R[2]","reason":"supply_demand_durability#0/#1 已被 R3 與觸發器 4 引用，並對應 bear 的需求疲弱路徑和 Q4 間夜門檻，沒有未接的負向 finding。"},{"item":"③","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"監管（regulatory_antitrust#0–#3、#5、#6）、通路（channel#1）、替代技術、訴訟、資安與 DSA 都已被 threats、R2 或 contradictions 接住；geo#2 有列入 evidence_dismissed 並說明理由。"},{"item":"④","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.decision_inputs.market_wrong_reason_given","reason":"「市場錯在哪」有具體內容（2%～3% 隱含年增 vs LLM 轉介遠低於 1%、B2C 行銷槓桿）；wait_for_price 為 null，裁決為進場且 exec_line 先建三分之一，與判斷不矛盾。"},{"item":"⑤","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.blind_spots","reason":"程式判 🟢；customer_second_source 無查詢記錄屬不適用，customer_concentration_credit 的查詢詞（無單一客戶占比重大）切題，OTA 業務不適用，缺口不影響結論。"},{"item":"⑥","light":"🟡","judgment_path":"$.answers.q2_moat.verdict_values.moat.roic_durability","reason":"ROIIC 因投入資本缺料而無法計算，reinvest_rate 只是 FCF 利潤率與營業利益率的比較，endo_ceiling 8% 是代理值（已由 endo_ceiling_basis 和 endo_ceiling_exceeded 處理共識 17.4%），屬資料缺口；情境樹對帳無誤（24.0×18=432、11.4×10.5=119.7、EV 72.3%、IRR 13.0% 皆與 scenario_meta 一致，Bull/Base 價差實質）。"},{"item":"⑦","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.answers.q1_business.fact_refs","reason":"引用的營運指標皆為 Q3 2026（2026-11-03 公告）口徑，舊季數字僅作對照並標明季別；consensus_rev_3m_pct 為 null，沒有以 stale 來源當唯一依據。"},{"item":"⑧","light":"🟢","judgment_path":"$.counter_evidence.contradictions","reason":"20 欄中有變動的 ma、val、price_at_dd、asym/ev5y/irr、bull/bear 價、max_dd、rearm_trigger 都對應到帶 cause 的條目；裁決與角色維持進場／衛星，方向未翻，期望報酬拆解屬程式歸因。"}]
